priorityList: Apply poisons and enter Stealth before combat.
Use Shadow Blades when Combo Points are low (<= 2) if Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are ready.
Use Shadow Dance if not stealthed and Combo Points are low (<= 2), provided Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racial buffs during Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance.
Use Shadowstrike if Darkest Night is active and Shadow Techniques has 5 or more stacks, provided Secret Technique is not ready.
Spend Combo Points on Secret Technique during Shadow Dance or if its cooldown is nearly finished.
Spend Combo Points on Eviscerate if Darkest Night is active.
Spend Combo Points on Coup de Grace if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Spend Combo Points on Eviscerate if other finishers are unavailable.
Use Vanish if not stealthed and at low Combo Points (<= 1) to refresh Stealth benefits.
Use Shadowstrike while Stealthed or in Shadow Dance to apply Deathstalker's Mark and build Combo Points.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Use Gloomblade (or Backstab) as a builder when not in Stealth and Energy is above 60.
Use Arcane Torrent if Energy is low to maintain momentum.
